lessons.title: Tamil vocabulary & word formation
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of tamil vocabulary & word formation and apply it accurately to unfamiliar tasks.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Azhagu Tamil combines vocabulary, grammar, idioms, reading, poetry and literary appreciation. Meaning depends on context, grammatical role and usage, so avoid selecting a word merely because it sounds familiar. Literary devices should be identified from their function in the passage. Focus specifically on tamil vocabulary & word formation. Identify the key concepts, common errors, evidence or performance criteria required, and a repeatable method for improvement. Move from recognition to application: understand the task, perform it carefully, check against the stated criteria, and record the reason for any error.
examples: A Azhagu Tamil Challenge task on tamil vocabulary & word formation should begin by identifying the exact clue, form or performance criterion being tested.
Create a new tamil vocabulary & word formation example with a plausible distractor or common error, then explain the correct response or performance.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Azhagu Tamil Challenge activity on tamil vocabulary & word formation using practice questions, a text, oral dialogue, puzzle, writing sample or performance sample as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on tamil vocabulary & word formation: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent performance on the third with explicit justification or self-check.
independent_practice: Complete three unfamiliar tamil vocabulary & word formation tasks without viewing the solution first.
Create one new example and complete it using the lesson method.
Review one error or weak performance and state the correction rule.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Azhagu Tamil Challenge checkpoint on tamil vocabulary & word formation; target at least six correct or meet the stated performance standard consistently.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Azhagu Tamil Challenge task demonstrating tamil vocabulary & word formation and record the evidence or self-assessment used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and repeatable self-correction. Encourage independent performance before intervention. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one concrete action for improving tamil vocabulary & word formation.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
